name: cuti-scenario-product-workflow
description: Create story-driven product advertisements in which a character pursues a goal, encounters a credible problem, and the product naturally changes the outcome so its value is understood through cause and effect. Use for scenario ads, branded micro-dramas, comedic product stories, lifestyle narratives, soft-sell commercials, or when the user explicitly invokes $cuti-scenario-product-workflow. Do not use for primarily visual product showcases, turntables, packshots, or specification-led demonstrations.
